hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -q '\.dart$' && dart format "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -q 'pubspec\.yaml$' && (cd "$(dirname "$f")" && flutter pub get); } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.dart$' && ! echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(g|freezed)\.dart$' && { output=$(flutter analyze "$f" 2>&1); echo "$output" | grep -qE 'error|warning|info' && printf '%s' "$output" | jq -Rs '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":("flutter analyze found issues in edited file:\n" + .)}}' || true; }; } 2>/dev/null || true
